_comment: Destination titles adjudicated as NOT mappable to a single O*NET SOC, and titles whose proposed mapping was killed in adversarial review. Read by scripts/destination-profiles.py: `nextbatch` skips refused titles and the programs they hold (a program clears only when EVERY title maps, so a program carrying a refused title cannot clear and its other titles are not live work). Full reasoning per title: docs/tasks/dfva-crosswalk-backfill.SKILL.md. Use `nextbatch N --all` to see the raw queue.

refused.title: Teacher
refused.why: Blocks primary and secondary programs at once; Elementary 25-2021 (84.74) vs Secondary 25-2031 (91.99) is a 7-point swing with no correct answer.

refused.title: Classroom Teacher
refused.why: Same level split; blocks mc-teachpr and mc-teachsa simultaneously.

refused.title: Casual Relief Teacher
refused.why: Same level split; blocks mc-teachpr and mc-teachsa simultaneously.

refused.title: English Teacher
refused.why: Blocks mc-apling (adult TESOL) and mc-teachpr (primary) — different occupations.

refused.title: Assistant Language Teacher
refused.why: Names a rank, not an occupation; level unfixed.

refused.title: Learning Support Teacher
refused.why: Special-education level spread; residual 25-2059 is the LOWEST of the family (raw AIOE Preschool 0.375 / K-Elem 0.736 / Middle 1.296 / Secondary 0.959 / All Other -0.663) — picking it is the Management Trainee failure mode.

refused.title: Special Education Teacher
refused.why: Same special-education level spread.

refused.title: Teacher of the Deaf
refused.why: Same special-education level spread.

refused.title: Specialist Remedial Teacher
refused.why: Same special-education level spread.

refused.title: Management Trainee
refused.why: Rule 5 fails: 'International Business' names no SOC. Candidates spread 20.4 points and 11-1021 is the lowest, so the row would systematically deflate mc-ib.

refused.title: Crime Prevention Officer
refused.why: Sworn divisional posting in VIC/NSW vs civilian community-safety read; Delta 43.46 to 33-3051 and the civilian side has no settled SOC.

refused.title: Family Violence & Review Officer
refused.why: Names a statutory function, not an occupation; 274ab record does not link titles to employers.

refused.title: Technical Leader
refused.why: Names seniority in an unspecified technical discipline; mc-eleceng record does not fix the occupation.

refused.title: Design Assistant
refused.why: Assistant + generic 'design'; the crosswalk's Assistant precedent is 6-for-6 on titles that name the discipline, and this one does not.

refused.title: Senior Product Manager
refused.why: Product management has no settled SOC — 11-2021 (94.93) is only shippable in a commit that also re-points Product Director (77.30), 15.67 points apart on one occupation at two ranks.

refused.title: Clinical Specialist
refused.why: Industry title (medical-device field role) vs clinical practitioner; unresolved for mc-biomeng.

refused.title: Innovation Manager
refused.why: Generic management title with no discipline anchor.

refused.title: Publishing Assistant
refused.why: Assistant rank with no occupation named; publishing spans editorial and production SOCs.

refused.title: Content Manager
refused.why: Verified candidate set spans marketing, editorial and web SOCs with no O*NET title anchor separating them — see the 11th run's candidate table.

refused.title: Agribusiness Graduate
refused.why: 'Graduate' is not an occupation.

refused.title: Research and Development Officer
refused.why: R&D spans the discipline; mc-agsc record does not fix which science.

refused.title: Head of National Beef Development
refused.why: Bespoke industry leadership title with no SOC analogue.

refused.title: Collections Assistant
refused.why: The Management Trainee shape with a twist — Assistant rank plus a museum/library ambiguity; candidates too far apart.

refused.title: Heritage consultant
refused.why: Heritage work spans archaeology, planning and architecture SOCs; band wider than previously recorded.

refused.title: Heritage Officer
refused.why: Same heritage span; no anchor separates the candidates.

overturned_with_replacement.title: Pilot Plant Operator
overturned_with_replacement.why: O*NET 19-4031 carries the literal task 'Operate experimental pilot plants'.

overturned_with_replacement.title: Cloud Solution Architect
overturned_with_replacement.why: 15-1199.02 lists 'Solutions Architect' as a reported title; 15-1143 is strictly LAN/WAN.

overturned_with_replacement.title: Full-Stack Web Developer | Python Django, Javascri
overturned_with_replacement.why: Matches Frontend Developer and Web Developer in the same record; Delta 2.66.

overturned_with_replacement.title: Nurse Research Coordinator
overturned_with_replacement.why: Senior Clinical Research Nurse -> 29-1141 is the exact precedent; Delta 25.03.

overturned_with_replacement.title: Analyst - Financial Crime Operations
overturned_with_replacement.why: O*NET 13-2099.04 Fraud Examiners is the literal home.
